text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So intense! Sengoku-era movies truly are 
the best!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If I had lived in the Sengoku period, I 
wonder whether I would have sided with the 
Western or Eastern Army...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If it's the Eastern Army, that's Tokugawa 
Ieyasu's side, and if it's the Western 
Army, that's Ishida Mitsunari's side, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The Eastern Army wins in the end, so 
normally you'd go with the Eastern Army, 
but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How do we turn the tide of battle?! Hngh!! 
The Western Army is hard to give up on 
too!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mmh, is it time for training...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However, soon comes the scene where 
Hideaki Kobayakawa turns traitor... 
Mmh-mmm-mmm.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
! Behold, they've turned traitor!! Now, 
what will you do?! How will you respond, 
Mitsunari?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason got so caught up in a movie that 
she ended up skipping her training.
